title: Web release gate and long-term trace evidence
manifestRules: repairable packs must declare install-capability --action repair --pack-id <pack-id>
camelCase and snake_case private runtime/path manifest fields are blockers

tests.command: $env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1'; python -m pytest tests/test_ecorex_web_parallel_backend.py -q -k "runtime_projection_api_returns_request_and_session_projection or web_stream_terminal_and_loss_converge_from_runtime_projection or web_history_load_refreshes_session_runtime_projection or image_jobs_api_starts_collects_and_projects_backend_job or web_file_serve_obeys_custom_filesystem_profile or capabilities_api_flattens_policy_capability_packs_for_frontend_contract"

tests.summary: bash syntax passed; WSL emitted benign localhost/NAT warnings on stderr
generated web-release-gate.json with releaseReady=true, blocking=0, packCount=9; confirmed provided workspace was not mutated

notes: The release gate is read-only for capabilities; it captures state and evaluates broker decisions but does not install, repair, configure, or start runtimes.
The permission matrix uses a temporary ECOREX_USER_DATA directory and temporary probe workspace so user/admin permission settings and the provided workspace are not mutated.
The Web installer requires EXPECTED_SHA256 for online release downloads and switches current only after dependency installation, baseline, and release gate pass.
Failure paths write release-gate artifacts instead of leaving only a traceback.
Permission summaries/audit entries redact Bearer credentials and JSON token/password/authorization fields.
Web/runtime visible version surfaces were advanced to v0.2.6; existing manifest artifact URLs remain generated by release packaging.
The generated review-consensus.md is an automated release artifact; the slice pass record remains docs/web-runtime-goal/reviews/S09-consensus.md after multi-agent review.
